text_block_list.name: Recap
text_block_list.text: Previously on our story! Amidst advice from various Trainers, Kiseki is urged by a certain Trainer close to her heart to rethink her entire strategy.

text_block_list.name: Recap
text_block_list.text: All because they believed Kiseki had it in her to create something truly magnificent. And on that stormy day, a brilliant breakthrough was born—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—...Fast forward a few weeks to the present.
Kiseki is practically bursting with excitement over the plan they forged together.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—...Fast forward a few weeks to the present.
Kiseki is practically bursting with excitement over the plan they forged together.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Ghhh, TRAIIINEEEER!!
And now, the day of the revenge mock race has arrived.

text_block_list.name: Mid-level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Why on earth did Kiseki turn me down?!
I could have polished her strongest assets to absolute perfection! And yet—!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
Well, it was Kiseki's choice. ...Tell me, Trainer.
Do you possess a strategy to bring her victory that the rest of us couldn't see?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer! Can we have one last quick strategy session?!
Just, like, two panels' worth! That's all I need!
choice_data_list: Of course. Let's shake off those nerves together.
Of course. Let's shake off those nerves together.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
*Inhale... exhale...* ...Let's review.
Back in the pouring rain, you praised my stamina and guts.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
And those words sparked a brand-new—an absolute masterpiece of a plan.
We're completely aligned on that, right?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Today, I'm going up against some insanely formidable rivals.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown-chan and Satono Diamond-chan from last time.
Plus... Cheval Grand-chan, Vivlos-chan's big sister.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Even against competitors overflowing with such overwhelming talent,
I'm going to—
choice_data_list: Put on the most thrilling race possible—and win.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Winning is what makes a true protagonist!
Just you wait... It's gonna be an absolute thrill ride!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: Done with your meeting? ...Watching her previous race, what Kiseki lacked in my eyes was proper energy conservation and the sharpness to cut through the pack.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Did you manage to drill the fundamentals into her to overcome those flaws?
choice_data_list: No. True brilliance often lies outside textbook formulas.

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text:
“...What? What does that even—”
“The race has started! Look, Kiseki is—!”

text_block_list.name: Trainers
text_block_list.text: Whaaat?! She's front-running?!

Surging forward aggressively, she seizes an unrelenting breakaway lead.
This was the unexpected plot twist she envisioned... a thrilling narrative all her own.

text_block_list.name: Mid-level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! Can Kiseki even hold that pace?!
She's never run from the front in a single training session before...!
choice_data_list: ...It's keeping you on the edge of your seat, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mid-level Trainer
text_block_list.text:
O-Of course it is! But wait!
Are you saying your plan is to convert Kiseki into a front-runner permanently?!
choice_data_list: No. Her optimal style changes with every single race.

text_block_list.text:
What Kiseki seeks is whatever performance will make the race most riveting.
And to seize victory from that sensational spectacle—becoming the true protagonist.

This strategy exists solely for this one-and-only mock race.
A winning run born from what she believes is the ultimate spectacle.

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text: ...Th-That's absurd! The golden rule of racing is for a runner to hone a consistent path to victory! To throw that away—!

text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer
text_block_list.text:
You really think she can pull it off with a style entirely different from before...?
Could such a thing... Could such an impossible twist actually come true...?!
choice_data_list: That's right! You just can't take your eyes off her!

text_block_list.text:
Alongside the Trainers whose eyes are glued to the track, I watch Kiseki intently.
Charging forward on a reckless solo crusade against an armada of powerhouse contenders.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haah... haah... Not... Not yet! Not yet, not yet, not yet!!

Her front-running surge caught the chasing pack completely off guard.
Everyone was watching her back. Everyone was cheering her on—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Kh!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer, I just know you're...
you're getting thrilled watching me run again, aren't you?)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
(Because my own heart is pounding like crazy right now!
I won't stop, I can't stop! All the way like this—)

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I'll win...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I will win...!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna wiiiiiiiiiin—!
And then, Kiseki—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Haah... haah...! 
...Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I... I took second place...!!

Kiseki's breakaway was overtaken in the final stretch.
...She fell just short of victory.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...B-But, but still! I was way more hyped than during the mock race,
and running felt more awesome than ever!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It was times more fun than creating something all by myself...!
And times more frustrating than losing alone, too...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I really wanted to win with you...!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...It made me so happy when you watched me!
And creating something together with you was so much fun! That's why—!!
choice_data_list: Kiseki! Sign a contract with me!!
Kiseki! I want you to sign a contract with me!!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Ah!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...And so, I took your hand.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —...This is our "story."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: What you and I are going to create—

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Is the most gripping, hot-blooded, 
manga-like tale of a miracle—a story of Kiseki.
